hookups.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880252&siteId=23636 ('No Modern Amenities: There are no electric, water, sewer hook-ups, or dump stations on state forest land. Campers are advised to bring their own water.') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern facilities, water, dump stations, or utility hook-ups on state forest lands'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Permit and reservation required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. The site is behind a locked gate off Sassafras Hill Road; gate instructions come with the confirmation. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; vacate at least 48 hours before returning. $10 a night PA residents, $15 non-residents.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/pinchot/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('Most campsites in Pennsylvania state forests can be reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site behind a locked gate off Sassafras Hill Road (Thornhurst Tract): gravel pull-through, max vehicle length 40 ft. 'This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large trailers.'

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers (state forest rule), single gravel pull-through site taking 40 ft behind a locked gate (instructions with the confirmation), reservation required. Not stated: a season for this site. Fees left as recorded (DCNR state forest rate).
